title: 【VR】横特化VR

synopsis: Released in March 2022, VRKM-565 is a JAV title produced by KM Produce starring Satsukiena. VRKM-565 is part of the ongoing VR line-up. The release is built around Beautiful Tits, Other Fetish and VR Exclusive themes, spanning a 92-minute programme. The 92-minute runtime gives the storyline space to develop naturally. Satsukiena brings her screen presence to VRKM-565, contributing a performance consistent with her wider catalog. The title is available to stream and download from its official FANZA source.
